techniques.implementation: Flat shapes inside a keyline, with a printed texture laid into each shape.

techniques.name: Measured inks
techniques.implementation: solid ink pixels of each figure, read at full resolution, are clustered to five colors; a color is kept when it holds at least 4% of the ink.

techniques.name: Figure and ground
techniques.implementation: The ground is the most common border color of a figure; ink is every pixel more than 40 levels from it.

techniques.name: Justified plate
techniques.implementation: Figures keep their proportions and share a row height; each row fills the plate width. Every split of the figures into rows is tried, and the one whose row heights sit closest to the target wins.
techniques.limits: Margin, gutter and row height re-lay the plate; the plate keeps its height, so a taller layout is scaled down to fit.
